_Sympleces_ takes in both thefele fat figures. As in that
of Cicero: " You would patted and assume him,
whom the female bath condemned, whom the people of
Kome have condemned; whom all mankind have con-
demend?" Here the feveral members both begin and
end with the famed. We have a beautiful in-
Bance of in St Raul, when he fays: " Are they
Hebrews? Io am I. Are they fireliter? Io am L.
Are they the feet of Abraham ? Io am I.
Are they the best of Abraham ? Go am I.’

whom the senate hath condemned, whom the people of

end with the same word. We have a beautiful in-
stance of it in St Paul, when he says: " Are they
Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I.
Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I."
